title: Projektetage Tile Fullscreen
description: Fix split tile fullscreen on projektetage catalogue slides: pressing fullscreen on a tile does not expand it to slide fullscreen.
summary: Interactive slide fullscreen no longer fills the entire slide (1×1). All figure, video, pdf, and split-tile fullscreen toggles use one centered frame (45%×42.5% slide space), midway between the Medienüberblick figure thumb (30%×35%) and video (60%×50%). Added SLIDE_INTERACTIVE_FULLSCREEN_FRAME; wrapper uses transformFrameStyle instead of inset:0; CSS no longer forces full-bleed dimensions. Fixed FigureMorphView dormantAnchor prop so morph-participant split anchors render with presentation-morph-slot--dormant. All 62 renderer tests pass.
